method: Read-only offline reconstruction uses recorded PolynomialTraj and existing native_reference sampling/interpolation, exact capture_inputs.base_stamp odom used by MPPI planning, recorded native_phase with native_time_scale==0 only. Predicts first nominal base control algebra, not a rollout or simulation. Current node on_odom accepts non-world odom only after identity world transform check; no independent TF was read here. Comparison is to actual controller numerical input convention, not a claimed externally calibrated world residual.
